formatDecision.actualDidacticDecision: KEEP native wide format: the three strategy panels and discussion group remain recognisable at both360and680px; no ratio change needed.

actualMotifAndLegibility: Migration/qualification, vocational training/tools and automation/robot remain three clear large motifs in all3actual views. The warm comic discussion group remains clear without reading the decorative mug/book/window microtext. At360px the principal headings and scenes can be distinguished; no crowded numerical table is required.
actualSubjectReview: All three strategies expressly required by current bilingual goal remain visible, with a group considering combinations. No automatic recruitment success, fixed numerical effect or exclusive correct strategy is asserted. Worker using tablet behind automation motif sees its actual front; certificate in migration motif is shown outward as presentation, not misread by its holder.
actualActorPerspectiveReview: KEEP: Actual new laptop presents its plain lid BACK toward external viewer, with screen toward the seated discussion group. The right notebook now contains neutral circles and abstract lines, with no directional readable strategy words or comparison data falsely facing the viewer; the seated woman can physically write at its near edge. Marks do not claim an upside-down readable dataset. Native/360/680 were all actually seen, no approval inferred from prompt alone.
